thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: routing.policy.evaluator error surge detected — severity: P1. Increased routing errors and downstream 5xxs across eu-west-1 -> oncall rotation paged. Runbook: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/routing-policy-fallback>
maya: picking up the page. seeing lots of 502/504 tails for model-serving requests to eu-west-1 (latency 2x normal). any recent config pushes?
devon: pushed schema migration for routing policies ~55m ago. it deprecated `region_hint` and introduced `region_selector`. migration included a strict validator but we missed a mapping for the legacy field. suspecting default fallback behavior changed.
sam: logs show router selecting fallback variant repeatedly which then triggers another fallback — looks like a loop. sample log:
```
2026-03-15T09:12:11Z router-eu-west-1 INFO select_variant req=abc123 policy_id=pol_77 eval=failed -> using fallback model=gptx-small-q region=us-east-1
2026-03-15T09:12:11Z router-eu-west-1 WARN cache-miss req=abc123 fallback-trigger
2026-03-15T09:12:12Z router-eu-west-1 INFO select_variant req=abc123 policy_id=pol_77 eval=failed -> using fallback model=gptx-small-q region=us-east-1
```
sam: that repeated selection indicates the new validator is treating the missing mapping as "no preference" and defaulting to global fallback. previously `region_hint: eu-west-1` would force local variant.
carla: customers reporting: AcmeCorp and NovaApps seeing degraded responses. CS triage: ~4 customers flagged, roughly 12% of traffic from eu-west-1 reduced success rate. CS assigned anna-cs to notify.
maya: immediate mitigation options?
devon: we have two paths: 1) quick rollback of the schema migration to restore legacy semantics; 2) patch the policy translator to map `region_hint -> region_selector` and push a hotfix. 1 is fastest but rollbacks have risk to other consumers. 2 is safe but takes ~20-30m to test.
maya: do 2 then, we can't risk other changes. can you draft the patch and I can apply to prod once reviewed?
devon: working on patch now. patch will add tolerant mapping in the router preprocessor and a runtime flag `ROUTER_LEGACY_REGION_MAPPING=true`.
maya: copying commands i'll run once you say ready. also i'll scale routing pods in eu-west-1 and disable canary routing for last hour to reduce thrash: `kubectl -n infra scale deploy/router-eu-west-1 --replicas=6`.
sam: also temporarily increasing short-circuit TTL to avoid repeated fallbacks: `redis-cli HSET router:config fallback_ttl 10s` (will monitor for side-effects).
devon: patch ready, tests pass. patch diff (abridged):
```
- // old: assume region_selector present
+ // new: if region_selector missing and region_hint present -> region_selector = map(region_hint)
+ if (!policy.region_selector && policy.region_hint) {
+   policy.region_selector = mapLegacyRegion(policy.region_hint)
+ }
```
maya: applying hotfix to eu-west-1 router now. deploying config id cfg_2148-hotfix. command:
```
redwoodctl deploy router --region eu-west-1 --image router:v2.4-hotfix --config cfg_2148-hotfix
kubectl -n infra rollout status deploy/router-eu-west-1
```
incident-bot: Deploy started by maya at 2026-03-15T09:27:02Z. Notifying on-call and qa.
zane: watching metrics. initial error rate trending down from 12% -> 3% in 3 mins. keep an eye on latency percentiles.
maya: hotfix rolled out, router restart complete. verifying traffic. logs show mapping applied:
```
2026-03-15T09:28:19Z router-eu-west-1 INFO policy-preproc mapped region_hint=eu-west-1 -> region_selector=eu-west-1
2026-03-15T09:28:19Z router-eu-west-1 INFO select_variant req=def456 policy_id=pol_77 variant=gptx-small-q region=eu-west-1
```
incident-bot: Monitoring: now 0.9% error rate in eu-west-1 (was 12%).
anna-cs: sent interim notice to impacted customers: "We've applied an operational fix and are monitoring. Expect nominal behavior shortly." :white_check_mark:
carla: nice work. do we still want a rollback? or keep hotfix and ship proper mapping in next release?
zane: keep hotfix, ship mapping upstream, and add CI check to fail schema migrations that remove deprecated fields without mappings. also add a canary gate so policy schema changes require a staged rollout flag.
devon: will create PRs: one for canonical mapping and one to add validator rule (CI). assigning to @devon and @zane for follow-up.
maya: I'll close the pager in 30m if metrics remain stable. please put a short postmortem in #postmortems and include timeline + root cause: schema migration removed legacy field mapping causing default fallback behavior -> regional fallback loop -> customer impact. action items: CI validator, canary gate, runbook update, customer follow-up.
incident-bot: Pager status: acknowledged -> mitigated. Auto-close timer set for 30m.
maya: leaving final note: root cause = config schema change removed implicit mapping for `region_hint` -> `region_selector`. missing migration mapping produced a silent default to global fallback, which created oscillating fallback selections and higher latency/5xx for a subset of tenants. lesson: schema changes that deprecate fields must include explicit mapping or validator rejects the change.
zane: will own the postmortem write-up. tagging @carla and @anna-cs for customer communication drafts. :spiral_notepad:
maya: thanks team. closing thread once timer expires and metrics stable. :thumbsup:
